A feed you already read, where the club can put a date.

The people, on an ordinary day.
The conversation that runs between meetings.
A social: an afternoon around a table at a bakery or a coffee shop, with no agenda to prepare for.
A study session: an evening working side by side on whatever each person is learning, with help when someone asks for it.

Nothing to prepare and nothing to read first.

The club has no front desk and no phone number; the chat is where you ask.
